# OpenAI MCP app transport

`transport.js` is the TypeScript-free form of the minimal app transport from
`openai/mcp-extensions`, commit `e314720a0daac326217d1f123fcf51647868fa9f`,
`typescript/src/app/transport.ts`.

Source: https://github.com/openai/mcp-extensions/blob/e314720a0daac326217d1f123fcf51647868fa9f/typescript/src/app/transport.ts

The transport is vendored so installed local plugins need no npm downloads.
Its Apache 2.0 license is preserved in `MCP-EXTENSIONS-LICENSE`.
